description: §5.2 "Data-supplied stylesheets (S472)" — what is NOT refused: a static `href` on a stylesheet `<link>`, and a data `href` on a `<link>` whose static `rel` holds no `stylesheet` (an icon, a `preload` with `as="style"`, a `<link>` with no `rel`). Codes only: the runtime write of a `<link>`'s data `href` is not asserted here (impl#1 does not lower a parenthesized `href=(…)` on `<link>` at all — it writes no `href`; §5.2 rule 3 judges the scheme where it is written). impl#1 built under the S479 carve-out 2 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S479-3B-rest-item-21).
rationale: §5.2: "Not refused: a static `href` (`<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/app.css\">`), and a data `href` on a `<link>` whose static `rel` holds no `stylesheet` (an icon — rule 3 still judges its scheme)."
